1947, January
The following is a faithful transcription of the handwritten original drafts of a message composed by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey O. F.M. Cap. for his Golden Jubilee Card.
Jan. 14 - 1897 - Jan. 14 - 1947
1897 - Jan. 14th - 1947
Thanks be to God for uncountable mercies - for all things. Thanks to my neighbor
for his charitable patience: fifty years of Capuchin life have almost unnoticed slipped
ahead of me into eternity - whither I hope to follow before half of another fifty. Deo Gratias.
Thanks be to God for uncount- able mercies - for every blessing: Thanks to my neighbor for his charitable patience; my first fifty years in the Order - almost unnoticed - has slipped away from me into eternal life.
Thither I hope to follow before half another fifty - trusting in the merciful goodness of God.
The Lord be praised in all His designs! Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
1897 - Jan. 14 - 1947 1897 1947
What shall I render to the Lord for all He hath done for me? He created me to know Him .. that includes all the rest - - God made me to know Him. O what a blessed Him! To love Him and serve Him Sure rests in the same. It's Heaven begun - For the grateful on earth - To treasure aright !!! - - Highest Heaven its worth. He permits me To-day to Start a second fifty years in the Order. "Quid retrbuam!" Now shall thank Him! May the rest of my Existence be an Eternal Deo Gratias-to God and my Neighbor! - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
PAX ET BONUM! IN MEMORY OF MY GOLDEN JUBILEE IN RELIGION
ST. BONAVENTURE MONASTERY DETRPOT. , OCJOGAM
